item.g:description: Black Vanilla is a gourmand scent from Mancera, created by Pierre Montale in 2017. It is unisex. White peach, black currant, coconut and Calabrian bergamot make a juicy opening. Violet, Egyptian jasmine and Bulgarian rose soften the heart, before Madagascar vanilla and white musk create a creamy, powdery finish. Best in autumn and winter, when its warmth really comes through. This is the generous 120ml eau de parfum spray.
item.g:product_type: Health & Beauty > Personal Care > Cosmetics > Perfumes & Colognes > Eaux de Parfum

item.g:title: Mancera Cedrat Boise Eau de Parfum 120ml Spray
item.g:description: Cedrat Boise is Mancera's fresh-woody classic, composed by Pierre Montale in 2011 and worn by men and women alike. Sicilian lemon, bergamot, black currant and spices create a sparkling, fruity start. Fruity notes, patchouli leaf and water jasmine form the heart, and cedar, leather, sandalwood, vanilla, white musk and moss give a smooth, long base. Easy to wear from spring to autumn. Supplied as a 120ml eau de parfum spray.
item.g:product_type: Health & Beauty > Personal Care > Cosmetics > Perfumes & Colognes > Eaux de Parfum

item.g:title: Montale Vanilla Extasy Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
item.g:description: Vanilla Extasy is a warm, sweet eau de parfum for women from Montale, created by Pierre Montale in 2008. Apricot and apricot blossom give a soft, fruity opening. Vanilla, ylang-ylang and jasmine fill out the heart, and benzoin, sandalwood, resins and mahogany make the base rich and long-lasting. A comforting choice for autumn and winter evenings. This is the 100ml spray.
item.g:product_type: Health & Beauty > Personal Care > Cosmetics > Perfumes & Colognes > Eaux de Parfum

item.g:title: Nishane Ambra Calabria Extrait de Parfum 50ml Spray
item.g:description: Ambra Calabria is a sunny, green extrait de parfum from Nishane, composed by Jorge Lee in 2015 and made for anyone. Bergamot, green leaves and galbanum make a crisp, sharp opening. Coriander and jasmine give the heart a light spiciness, and amber, vanilla and musk warm the dry-down without making it heavy. Wonderful in spring and summer. This bottle is the 50ml spray.
item.g:product_type: Health & Beauty > Personal Care > Cosmetics > Perfumes & Colognes > Eaux de Parfum

item.g:title: Nishane Colognise Extrait de Cologne 100ml Spray
item.g:description: Colognise is Nishane's extrait de cologne, a richer, longer-lasting take on a classic fresh cologne. It is made for men and women. Bergamot, lemon, green tea and jasmine create a bright, clean opening. Grapefruit and lily-of-the-valley soften the heart, and vetiver, neroli and musk give a smooth, gentle finish. An easy everyday scent, and lovely after a shower on a warm day. This is the 100ml spray.
item.g:product_type: Health & Beauty > Personal Care > Cosmetics > Perfumes & Colognes

item.g:title: Nishane Hacivat X Extrait de Parfum 100ml Spray
item.g:description: Hacivat X is a 2023 Nishane creation by Julien Rasquinet. It is a unisex extrait de parfum with a fresh, woody character. Pineapple, bergamot and pink pepper open the scent. Lime, Tunisian orange blossom and jasmine bring a bright, floral heart, and Haitian vetiver, patchouli and cedar give it a dry, polished base. Comfortable in spring, summer and autumn. This is the 100ml spray.
item.g:product_type: Health & Beauty > Personal Care > Cosmetics > Perfumes & Colognes > Eaux de Parfum

item.g:title: The Merchant of Venice Arabesque Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
item.g:description: Arabesque is a warm, spiced eau de parfum from The Merchant of Venice, released in 2015 and worn by men and women. Plum, tobacco leaf and ginger make a fruity, slightly smoky opening. Cinnamon, tonka bean and cedar form the heart, and benzoin, musk and vetiver give a sweet, resinous dry-down. Well suited to autumn and winter evenings. This is the 100ml spray.
item.g:product_type: Health & Beauty > Personal Care > Cosmetics > Perfumes & Colognes > Eaux de Parfum

item.g:title: The Merchant of Venice Craquele Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
item.g:description: Craquele by The Merchant of Venice is a unisex eau de parfum with a leathery, woody heart, first released in 2015. Cypress, violet leaf and red thyme give a green, herbal start. Saffron, cedar and freesia follow, and leather, incense and white musk make a smoky, elegant base. Best in autumn and winter, for evenings and dressed-up occasions. This bottle is the 100ml spray.
item.g:product_type: Health & Beauty > Personal Care > Cosmetics > Perfumes & Colognes > Eaux de Parfum

item.g:title: The Merchant of Venice Cyprus Shell Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
item.g:description: Cyprus Shell is a 2025 eau de parfum from The Merchant of Venice, composed by Gaël Montero. It is soft, powdery and unisex. Pear, salt and mandarin open with a fresh, coastal feel. Orris, rose and incense make the heart quietly elegant, and musk, Ambrofix, oakmoss and patchouli give a clean, lasting base. A good companion for spring and summer. This is the 100ml spray.
item.g:product_type: Health & Beauty > Personal Care > Cosmetics > Perfumes & Colognes > Eaux de Parfum

item.g:title: The Merchant of Venice La Fenice Pour Femme Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
item.g:description: La Fenice Pour Femme is a sweet floral eau de parfum for women from The Merchant of Venice, launched in 2016. Hawthorn and mandarin orange open it brightly. Almond blossom, tuberose and heliotrope make the heart soft and creamy, and vanilla, tonka bean and cedar give a warm, gentle finish. Lovely from autumn through spring. This bottle is the 100ml spray.
item.g:product_type: Health & Beauty > Personal Care > Cosmetics > Perfumes & Colognes > Eaux de Parfum

item.g:title: The Merchant of Venice La Fenice Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
item.g:description: La Fenice Pour Homme is a fresh, spicy eau de parfum for men from The Merchant of Venice, released in 2016. Violet leaf, mandarin orange, apple blossom and olibanum open the scent. Basil, iris, black pepper and cloves give a peppery heart, and leather, cedar and amber anchor it. Fresh enough for spring and summer, with a smart, grown-up character. This is the 100ml spray.
item.g:product_type: Health & Beauty > Personal Care > Cosmetics > Perfumes & Colognes > Eaux de Parfum

item.g:title: The Merchant of Venice Ottoman Amber Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
item.g:description: Ottoman Amber is a deep amber eau de parfum for men from The Merchant of Venice, first released in 2015. Plum, geranium and bergamot make a fruity, aromatic opening. Sandalwood and patchouli form the heart, while myrrh, labdanum, vanilla and agarwood (oud) give a dark, resinous base. A natural choice for autumn and winter evenings. Supplied as a 100ml spray.
item.g:product_type: Health & Beauty > Personal Care > Cosmetics > Perfumes & Colognes > Eaux de Parfum

item.g:title: The Merchant of Venice Red Potion Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
item.g:description: Red Potion is a 2019 eau de parfum from The Merchant of Venice, sweet and herbal at the same time and suited to anyone. Marigold, immortelle and orange create a warm, golden opening. Orange blossom, rosemary and honeysuckle make up the heart, and tonka bean, sandalwood and moss round it off. Best enjoyed in autumn and winter. This is the 100ml spray.
item.g:product_type: Health & Beauty > Personal Care > Cosmetics > Perfumes & Colognes > Eaux de Parfum

item.g:title: The Merchant of Venice Rosa Moceniga Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
item.g:description: Rosa Moceniga is a rose lover's eau de parfum for women from The Merchant of Venice, released in 2016. Rose, Sicilian bergamot and cassis open the scent. More rose comes through in the heart with magnolia and pink lotus, and the base pairs rose with musk, vanilla absolute, crystal amber and white cedar. Fresh, floral and perfect for spring. This is the 100ml spray.
item.g:product_type: Health & Beauty > Personal Care > Cosmetics > Perfumes & Colognes > Eaux de Parfum

item.g:title: Chloe Gift Set 100ml Eau de Parfum + 100ml Body Lotion + 5ml Eau de Parfum
item.g:description: This Chloe gift set holds a 100ml Chloe Eau de Parfum spray, a 100ml body lotion and a 5ml eau de parfum miniature for your bag. The fragrance is a soft, powdery rose for women: peony, lychee and freesia at the top, rose, lily-of-the-valley and magnolia in the heart, and Virginia cedar and amber at the base. A generous set that makes a special present for someone who loves floral scents.
item.g:product_type: Health & Beauty > Personal Care > Cosmetics > Perfumes & Colognes > Eaux de Parfum

item.g:title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray for Women
item.g:description: This is the women's Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue eau de toilette, created by Olivier Cresp in 2001, in the large 200ml spray. Sicilian lemon, apple, cedar and bellflower give a crisp, sunny opening. Bamboo, jasmine and white rose form a light floral heart, and cedar, musk and amber leave a clean, woody finish. Fresh and easy to wear, it is a summer favourite for days at the beach, holidays and warm evenings. Not to be confused with Light Blue Pour Homme, the men's version.

item.g:title: The Merchant of Venice Suave Petals Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
item.g:description: Suave Petals is a soft, fruity floral eau de parfum for women from The Merchant of Venice, first released in 2013. This is the larger 100ml spray. Nectarine blossom, nectarine, pineapple, apple and bergamot make a juicy, sunny opening. White rose, orris, orange blossom and tuberose form a powdery floral heart, and patchouli, sandalwood, vanilla and amber give a warm, smooth finish. A graceful choice for spring days and celebrations, in the house's striped Murano-style bottle.
item.g:product_type: Health & Beauty > Personal Care > Cosmetics > Perfumes & Colognes > Eaux de Parfum

item.g:title: Bvlgari Rose Goldea Blossom Delight Gift Set 50ml Eau de Parfum + 75ml Body Milk
item.g:description: This Bvlgari gift set holds a 50ml Rose Goldea Blossom Delight eau de parfum spray and a 75ml body milk. The fragrance, by Alberto Morillas (2019), is a fresh rose for women. Papaya, violet leaf and jasmine open it, rose, rose leaf and lily-of-the-valley form the heart, and Bulgarian rose, white musk and amber finish it softly. A pretty gift for spring birthdays and celebrations.
